title: Primary math: word problems with Polya
description: Four lessons teaching Polya’s four steps — understand, plan, carry out, look back — applied to real word problems with transfer.
assumptions: Whole-number arithmetic; problems solvable by one or two operations.
stage2goal: Carry out and look back; transfer to new problems.
understand.title: Understand the problem
understand.goal: Identify what is known and what is asked.
understand.reading: Polya step 1: restate the problem in your own words; list knowns and the unknown before computing.
understand.worked.prompt: Restate: “Ana has 5 apples, buys 3 more. How many now?” What is asked?
understand.known.prompt: “Tom had 12 stickers, gave 4 away.” What is known?
understand.known.a.label: 12 and 4
understand.independent.prompt: “A bus holds 40; 25 seated. How many empty seats?” Asked?
understand.independent.a.label: Total seats
understand.independent.b.label: Empty seats
understand.c1.a.label: understand
understand.c1.b.label: compute
plan.title: Choose a plan
plan.goal: Choose the operation that matches the situation.
plan.reading: Polya step 2: decide the operation. Joining → add; removing → subtract; equal groups → multiply; sharing → divide.
plan.order.fb: Understand, plan, carry out, look back.
plan.order.u.label: understand
plan.order.p.label: plan
plan.order.c.label: carry out
plan.order.l.label: look back
plan.transfer-plan.prompt: “24 cookies shared equally among 6 kids.” Plan?
plan.transfer-plan.a.label: Multiply
plan.transfer-plan.b.label: Divide
plan.c1.a.label: add
plan.c1.b.label: subtract
carry-out.title: Carry out and check
carry-out.goal: Execute the plan and verify the answer makes sense.
carry-out.reading: Polya step 3: compute carefully; step 4 begins by checking the answer against the situation.
carry-out.struggle: Without computing, explain how you would check whether “40 - 25 = 15 empty seats” makes sense.
carry-out.worked.prompt: How does adding 15 + 25 check the subtraction?
carry-out.compute.prompt: 24 cookies shared by 6 kids: each gets?
carry-out.transfer-check.prompt: You got 40 + 25 = 65 empty seats. Why wrong?
carry-out.transfer-check.fb: Empty seats must be fewer than 40.
carry-out.transfer-check.a.label: Empty seats must be fewer than 40
carry-out.transfer-check.b.label: Addition is always wrong
carry-out.c1.prompt: Checking with the inverse operation is…
carry-out.c1.a.label: step 1
carry-out.c1.b.label: look back
look-back.title: Look back and transfer
look-back.goal: Generalize the method to new problems.
look-back.reading: Polya step 4: ask “can I use this method elsewhere?” Transferring the plan is the goal of problem solving.
look-back.worked.prompt: Why does the same plan work for apples and stickers?
look-back.worked.content: 5+3 apples and 12+4 stickers share the joining structure.
look-back.transfer-new.prompt: A shelf has 32 books; 18 borrowed. How many left?
look-back.transfer-structure.prompt: Which problem uses the same plan as “24 shared by 6”?
look-back.transfer-structure.a.label: 30 plus 5
look-back.transfer-structure.b.label: 30 split into 5 equal teams
look-back.c1.a.label: can this method transfer?
look-back.c1.b.label: what is the answer?
look-back.c2.a.label: numbers
look-back.c2.b.label: structure
